verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הוֹדַ֥ע אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hō·w·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim ’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Son of man confront - Jerusalem with her abominations

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־ אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ אָמַ֨ר לִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מְכֹרֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וּמֹ֣לְדֹתַ֔יִךְ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י אָבִ֥יךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְאִמֵּ֥ךְ חִתִּֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar lî·rū·šā·lim mə·ḵō·rō·ṯa·yiḵ ū·mō·lə·ḏō·ṯa·yiḵ mê·’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’ā·ḇîḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’im·mêḵ ḥit·tîṯ
verses.literal: and tell [her that] this is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem Your origin and your birth were in the land of the Canaanites Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite

verses.original: בְּי֨וֹם וּמוֹלְדוֹתַ֗יִךְ הוּלֶּ֤דֶת שָׁרֵּ֔ךְ לֹֽא־ כָרַּ֣ת אֹתָךְ֙ לֹֽא־ רֻחַ֖צְתְּ וּבְמַ֥יִם לְמִשְׁעִ֑י לֹ֣א וְהָמְלֵ֙חַ֙ הֻמְלַ֔חַתְּ וְהָחְתֵּ֖ל לֹ֥א חֻתָּֽלְתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm ū·mō·wl·ḏō·w·ṯa·yiḵ hūl·le·ḏeṯ šār·rêḵ lō- ḵār·raṯ ’ō·ṯāḵ lō- ru·ḥaṣt ū·ḇə·ma·yim lə·miš·‘î lō wə·hā·mə·lê·aḥ hum·la·ḥat wə·hā·ḥə·têl lō ḥut·tā·lət
verses.literal: On the day of your birth - your cord was not cut - nor were you washed with water for cleansing You were not rubbed with salt . . . or wrapped in cloths . . . -

verses.original: לֹא־ חָ֨סָה עַ֗יִן עָלַ֜יִךְ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֛ךְ אַחַ֥ת מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לְחֻמְלָ֣ה עָלָ֑יִךְ וַֽתֻּשְׁלְכִ֞י אֶל־ פְּנֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ בְּגֹ֣עַל בְּי֖וֹם הֻלֶּ֥דֶת אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ḥā·sāh ‘a·yin ‘ā·la·yiḵ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lāḵ ’a·ḥaṯ mê·’êl·leh lə·ḥum·lāh ‘ā·lā·yiḵ wat·tuš·lə·ḵî ’el- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh nap̄·šêḵ bə·ḡō·‘al bə·yō·wm hul·le·ḏeṯ ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: No one cared enough . . . for you to do even one of these things out of compassion for you Instead, you were thrown out into the open field because you were despised on the day of your birth -

verses.original: וָאֶעֱבֹ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ וָֽאֶרְאֵ֔ךְ מִתְבּוֹסֶ֖סֶת בְּדָמָ֑יִךְ בְּדָמַ֣יִךְ וָאֹ֤מַר לָךְ֙ חֲיִ֔י בְּדָמַ֥יִךְ וָאֹ֥מַר לָ֖ךְ חֲיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’er·’êḵ miṯ·bō·w·se·seṯ bə·ḏā·mā·yiḵ bə·ḏā·ma·yiḵ wā·’ō·mar lāḵ ḥă·yî bə·ḏā·ma·yiḵ wā·’ō·mar lāḵ ḥă·yî
verses.literal: Then I passed by and saw you wallowing in your blood and as you lay there in your blood I said to you Live [There] I said to you Live

verses.original: נְתַתִּ֔יךְ רְבָבָ֗ה כְּצֶ֤מַח הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וַתִּרְבִּי֙ וַֽתִּגְדְּלִ֔י וַתָּבֹ֖אִי בַּעֲדִ֣י עֲדָיִ֑ים שָׁדַ֤יִם נָכֹ֙נוּ֙ וּשְׂעָרֵ֣ךְ צִמֵּ֔חַ וְאַ֖תְּ עֵרֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ṯat·tîḵ rə·ḇā·ḇāh kə·ṣe·maḥ haś·śā·ḏeh wat·tir·bî wat·tiḡ·də·lî wat·tā·ḇō·’î ba·‘ă·ḏî ‘ă·ḏā·yîm šā·ḏa·yim nā·ḵō·nū ū·śə·‘ā·rêḵ ṣim·mê·aḥ wə·’at ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh
verses.literal: I made you thrive like a plant of the field You grew up and matured and became . . . very beautiful Your breasts were formed and your hair grew but you were naked and bare

verses.original: וָאֶעֱבֹ֨ר עָלַ֜יִךְ וָאֶרְאֵ֗ךְ וְהִנֵּ֤ה עִתֵּךְ֙ עֵ֣ת דֹּדִ֔ים וָאֶפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֲכַסֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתֵ֑ךְ וָאֶשָּׁ֣בַֽע לָ֠ךְ וָאָב֨וֹא בִבְרִ֜ית אֹתָ֗ךְ וַתִּ֥הְיִי לִֽי׃ נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wā·’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’er·’êḵ wə·hin·nêh ‘it·têḵ ‘êṯ dō·ḏîm wā·’ep̄·rōś kə·nā·p̄î ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’ă·ḵas·seh ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ wā·’eš·šā·ḇa‘ lāḵ wā·’ā·ḇō·w ḇiḇ·rîṯ ’ō·ṯāḵ wat·tih·yî lî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then I passed by and saw you and you were indeed old enough . . . for love So I spread My cloak over you and covered your nakedness I pledged Myself to you entered into a covenant with you and you became Mine declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וָאֶרְחָצֵ֣ךְ בַּמַּ֔יִם וָאֶשְׁטֹ֥ף דָּמַ֖יִךְ מֵֽעָלָ֑יִךְ וָאֲסֻכֵ֖ךְ בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·ḥā·ṣêḵ bam·ma·yim wā·’eš·ṭōp̄ dā·ma·yiḵ mê·‘ā·lā·yiḵ wā·’ă·su·ḵêḵ baš·šā·men
verses.literal: Then I bathed you with water rinsed off your blood . . . and anointed you with oil

verses.original: וָאַלְבִּישֵׁ֣ךְ רִקְמָ֔ה וָאֶנְעֲלֵ֖ךְ תָּ֑חַשׁ וָאֶחְבְּשֵׁ֣ךְ בַּשֵּׁ֔שׁ וַאֲכַסֵּ֖ךְ מֶֽשִׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’al·bî·šêḵ riq·māh wā·’en·‘ă·lêḵ tā·ḥaš wā·’eḥ·bə·šêḵ baš·šêš wa·’ă·ḵas·sêḵ me·šî
verses.literal: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of fine leather I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk

verses.original: וָאֶעְדֵּ֖ךְ עֶ֑דִי וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה צְמִידִים֙ עַל־ יָדַ֔יִךְ וְרָבִ֖יד עַל־ גְּרוֹנֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e‘·dêḵ ‘e·ḏî wā·’et·tə·nāh ṣə·mî·ḏîm ‘al- yā·ḏa·yiḵ wə·rā·ḇîḏ ‘al- gə·rō·w·nêḵ
verses.literal: I adorned you with jewelry and I put bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֥ן נֶ֙זֶם֙ עַל־ אַפֵּ֔ךְ וַעֲגִילִ֖ים עַל־ אָזְנָ֑יִךְ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת בְּרֹאשֵֽׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên ne·zem ‘al- ’ap·pêḵ wa·‘ă·ḡî·lîm ‘al- ’ā·zə·nā·yiḵ tip̄·’e·reṯ wa·‘ă·ṭe·reṯ bə·rō·šêḵ
verses.literal: I put a ring in your nose earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown upon your head

verses.original: וַתַּעְדִּ֞י זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף וּמַלְבּוּשֵׁךְ֙ שֵׁשִׁי וָמֶ֙שִׁי֙ וְרִקְמָ֔ה אָכָלְתִּי סֹ֧לֶת וּדְבַ֛שׁ וָשֶׁ֖מֶן בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַתִּ֙יפִי֙ וַֽתִּצְלְחִ֖י לִמְלוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta‘·dî zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ū·mal·bū·šêḵ šē·šī wā·me·šî wə·riq·māh ʾå̄·ḵå̄·lə·tī sō·leṯ ū·ḏə·ḇaš wā·še·men bim·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ wat·tî·p̄î wat·tiṣ·lə·ḥî lim·lū·ḵāh
verses.literal: So you were adorned with gold and silver and your clothing [was made of] fine linen silk and embroidered cloth You ate fine flour honey and oil You became very . . . beautiful and rose to be queen

verses.original: לָ֥ךְ שֵׁ֛ם וַיֵּ֨צֵא בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם בְּיָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י׀ ה֗וּא כָּלִ֣יל בַּֽהֲדָרִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי עָלַ֔יִךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lāḵ šêm way·yê·ṣê bag·gō·w·yim bə·yā·p̄ə·yêḵ kî hū kā·lîl ba·hă·ḏā·rî ’ă·šer- śam·tî ‘ā·la·yiḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty for it [was] perfect in the splendor - I bestowed on you declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: עַל־ שְׁמֵ֑ךְ וַתִּבְטְחִ֣י בְיָפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֖י וַתִּשְׁפְּכִ֧י אֶת־ תַּזְנוּתַ֛יִךְ עַל־ כָּל־ עוֹבֵ֖ר לוֹ־ יֶֽהִי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- šə·mêḵ wat·tiḇ·ṭə·ḥî ḇə·yā·p̄ə·yêḵ wat·tiz·nî wat·tiš·pə·ḵî ’eṯ- taz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al- kāl- ‘ō·w·ḇêr lōw- ye·hî
verses.literal: But because of your fame you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot You lavished - your favors on everyone who passed by and your beauty was theirs for the asking

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֣י מִבְּגָדַ֗יִךְ וַתַּֽעֲשִׂי־ טְלֻא֔וֹת בָּמ֣וֹת לָךְ֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּזְנִ֖י לֹ֥א בָא֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî mib·bə·ḡā·ḏa·yiḵ wat·ta·‘ă·śî- ṭə·lu·’ō·wṯ bā·mō·wṯ lāḵ ‘ă·lê·hem wat·tiz·nî lō ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·lō yih·yeh
verses.literal: You took some of your garments and made colorful high places for yourself and on them you prostituted yourself Such things should not have happened never should they have occurred

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֞י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ כְּלֵ֣י מִזְּהָבִ֤י וּמִכַּסְפִּי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וַתַּעֲשִׂי־ לָ֖ךְ זָכָ֑ר צַלְמֵ֣י בָֽם׃ וַתִּזְנִי־
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ kə·lê miz·zə·hā·ḇî ū·mik·kas·pî ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ wat·ta·‘ă·śî- lāḵ zā·ḵār ṣal·mê ḇām wat·tiz·nî-
verses.literal: You also took the fine jewelry of gold and silver - I had given you and you made male idols with which to prostitute yourself

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֛י אֶת־ רִקְמָתֵ֖ךְ בִּגְדֵ֥י וַתְּכַסִּ֑ים נָתַתִּי וְשַׁמְנִי֙ וּקְטָרְתִּ֔י לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî ’eṯ- riq·mā·ṯêḵ biḡ·ḏê wat·tə·ḵas·sîm nå̄·ṯat·tī wə·šam·nî ū·qə·ṭā·rə·tî lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: You took - your embroidered garments to cover them and you set My oil and incense before them

verses.original: נָתַ֨תִּי לָ֜ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם נִיחֹ֖חַ לְרֵ֥יחַ וְלַחְמִי֩ אֲשֶׁר־ וּנְתַתִּ֧יהוּ סֹ֣לֶת וָשֶׁ֤מֶן וּדְבַשׁ֙ הֶֽאֱכַלְתִּ֔יךְ וַיֶּ֑הִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ lip̄·nê·hem nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ wə·laḥ·mî ’ă·šer- ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hū sō·leṯ wā·še·men ū·ḏə·ḇaš he·’ĕ·ḵal·tîḵ way·ye·hî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And you set before them as a pleasing aroma the food - I had given you the fine flour oil and honey that I had fed you That is what happened declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֞י אֶת־ בָּנַ֤יִךְ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלַ֣דְתְּ לִ֔י וַתִּזְבָּחִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם לֶאֱכ֑וֹל מִתַּזְנֻתֵךְ׃ הַמְעַ֖ט
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî ’eṯ- bā·na·yiḵ wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer yā·laḏt lî wat·tiz·bā·ḥîm lā·hem le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl mit·taz·nu·ṯēḵ ham·‘aṭ
verses.literal: You even took - the sons - and daughters - you bore to Me and sacrificed them as food to idols Was your prostitution not enough

verses.original: וַֽתִּשְׁחֲטִ֖י אֶת־ בָּנָ֑י וַֽתִּתְּנִ֔ים בְּהַעֲבִ֥יר אוֹתָ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·ḥă·ṭî ’eṯ- bā·nāy wat·tit·tə·nîm bə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr ’ō·w·ṯām lā·hem
verses.literal: You slaughtered - My children and delivered them up through the fire - to [idols]

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְתַזְנֻתַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א זָכַרְתִּי אֶת־ יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ בִּֽהְיוֹתֵךְ֙ עֵרֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֔ה מִתְבּוֹסֶ֥סֶת בְּדָמֵ֖ךְ הָיִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·ṯaz·nu·ṯa·yiḵ lō zå̄·ḵar·tī ’eṯ- yə·mê nə·‘ū·rā·yiḵ bih·yō·w·ṯêḵ ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh miṯ·bō·w·se·seṯ bə·ḏā·mêḵ hā·yîṯ
verses.literal: And in all your abominations and acts of prostitution you did not remember - the days of your youth when you were naked and bare wallowing in your own blood . . .

verses.original: א֣וֹי א֣וֹי לָ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ וַיְהִ֕י אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל־ רָעָתֵ֑ךְ
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w ’ō·w lāḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Woe Woe to you declares the Lord GOD And in addition to all your other wickedness

verses.original: וַתִּבְנִי־ לָ֖ךְ גֶּ֑ב וַתַּעֲשִׂי־ לָ֥ךְ רָמָ֖ה בְּכָל־ רְחֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḇ·nî- lāḵ gɛḇ wat·ta·‘ă·śî- lāḵ rā·māh bə·ḵāl rə·ḥō·wḇ
verses.literal: you built yourself a mound and made yourself a lofty shrine in every public square

verses.original: אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל־ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בָּנִית֙ רָֽמָתֵ֔ךְ וַתְּתַֽעֲבִי֙ יָפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתַּרְבִּ֖י אֶת־ תַּזְנֻתֵךְ׃ אֶת־ וַתְּפַשְּׂקִ֥י אֶת־ רַגְלַ֖יִךְ לְכָל־ עוֹבֵ֑ר
verses.transliteration: ’el- rōš kāl- de·reḵ bā·nîṯ rā·mā·ṯêḵ wat·tə·ṯa·‘ă·ḇî yā·p̄ə·yêḵ wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- taz·nu·ṯēḵ ’eṯ- wat·tə·p̄aś·śə·qî ’eṯ- raḡ·la·yiḵ lə·ḵāl ‘ō·w·ḇêr
verses.literal: At the head of every street you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty With increasing - promiscuity - you spread - your legs to all who passed by

verses.original: וַתִּזְנִ֧י אֶל־ גִּדְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֑ר שְׁכֵנַ֖יִךְ מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּנֵֽי־ וַתַּרְבִּ֥י אֶת־ תַּזְנֻתֵ֖ךְ לְהַכְעִיסֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiz·nî ’el- giḏ·lê ḇā·śār šə·ḵê·na·yiḵ miṣ·ra·yim bə·nê- wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- taz·nu·ṯêḵ lə·haḵ·‘î·sê·nî
verses.literal: You prostituted yourself with your lustful . . . neighbors the Egyptians and increased - your promiscuity to provoke Me to anger

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֶגְרַ֖ע חֻקֵּ֑ךְ וָאֶתְּנֵ֞ךְ בְּנֶ֤פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הַנִּכְלָמ֖וֹת זִמָּֽה׃ מִדַּרְכֵּ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’eḡ·ra‘ ḥuq·qêḵ wā·’et·tə·nêḵ bə·ne·p̄eš śō·nə·’ō·w·ṯa·yiḵ bə·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm han·niḵ·lā·mō·wṯ zim·māh mid·dar·kêḵ
verses.literal: Therefore I stretched out My hand against you and reduced your portion I gave you over to the desire of those who hate you the daughters of the Philistines who were ashamed of your lewd conduct

verses.original: וַתִּזְנִי֙ אֶל־ אַשּׁ֔וּר בְּנֵ֣י מִבִּלְתִּ֖י שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃ וַתִּזְנִ֕ים וְגַ֖ם לֹ֥א שָׂבְעָתֵ֑ךְ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiz·nî ’el- ’aš·šūr bə·nê mib·bil·tî śā·ḇā·‘at wat·tiz·nîm wə·ḡam lō śā·ḇə·‘ā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Then you prostituted yourself with the Assyrians . . . because you were not yet satisfied Even after [that] you were still not satisfied

verses.original: וַתַּרְבִּ֧י אֶת־ תַּזְנוּתֵ֛ךְ אֶל־ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ימָה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן וְגַם־ בְּזֹ֖את לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- taz·nū·ṯêḵ ’el- kaś·dî·māh ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an wə·ḡam- bə·zōṯ lō śā·ḇā·‘at
verses.literal: So you extended - your promiscuity to Chaldea the land of merchants but even with this you were not satisfied

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֲמֻלָה֙ לִבָּתֵ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה בַּעֲשׂוֹתֵךְ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֔לֶּה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה שַׁלָּֽטֶת׃ אִשָּֽׁה־ זוֹנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: māh ’ă·mu·lāh lib·bā·ṯêḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ba·‘ă·śō·w·ṯêḵ ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh ma·‘ă·śêh šal·lā·ṭeṯ ’iš·šāh- zō·w·nāh
verses.literal: How weak-willed is your heart declares the Lord GOD while you do - all these things the acts of a shameless . . . prostitute

verses.original: בִּבְנוֹתַ֤יִךְ גַּבֵּךְ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כָּל־ דֶּ֔רֶךְ עָשִׂיתִי וְרָמָתֵ֥ךְ בְּכָל־ רְח֑וֹב הָיִיתי וְלֹא־ כַּזּוֹנָ֖ה לְקַלֵּ֥ס אֶתְנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: biḇ·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ gab·bêḵ bə·rōš kāl- de·reḵ ʿå̄·śī·ṯī wə·rā·mā·ṯêḵ bə·ḵāl rə·ḥō·wḇ hå̄·yī·ṯ wə·lō- kaz·zō·w·nāh lə·qal·lês ’eṯ·nān
verses.literal: But when you built your mounds at the head of every street and made your lofty shrines in every public square you were not even like a prostitute because you scorned payment

verses.original: הַמְּנָאָ֑פֶת הָאִשָּׁ֖ה תִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־ זָרִֽים׃ תַּ֣חַת אִישָׁ֔הּ
verses.transliteration: ham·mə·nā·’ā·p̄eṯ hā·’iš·šāh tiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- zā·rîm ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šāh
verses.literal: You adulterous wife . . . You receive - strangers instead of your own husband

verses.original: יִתְּנוּ־ נֵ֑דֶה לְכָל־ זֹנ֖וֹת וְאַ֨תְּ נָתַ֤תְּ אֶת־ נְדָנַ֙יִךְ֙ לְכָל־ מְאַֽהֲבַ֔יִךְ וַתִּשְׁחֳדִ֣י אוֹתָ֗ם לָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֛יִךְ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yit·tə·nū- nê·ḏeh lə·ḵāl zō·nō·wṯ wə·’at nā·ṯat ’eṯ- nə·ḏā·na·yiḵ lə·ḵāl mə·’a·hă·ḇa·yiḵ wat·tiš·ḥo·ḏî ’ō·w·ṯām lā·ḇō·w ’ê·la·yiḵ mis·sā·ḇîḇ bə·ṯaz·nū·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Men give gifts to all [their] prostitutes but you gave - gifts to all your lovers You bribed them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors

verses.original: בָ֨ךְ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֔יִךְ וַיְהִי־ הֵ֤פֶךְ מִן־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ לֹ֣א וְאַחֲרַ֖יִךְ זוּנָּ֑ה וּבְתִתֵּ֣ךְ אֶתְנָ֗ן לֹ֥א נִתַּן־ וְאֶתְנַ֛ן לָ֖ךְ וַתְּהִ֥י לְהֶֽפֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇāḵ bə·ṯaz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ way·hî- hê·p̄eḵ min- han·nā·šîm lō wə·’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ zūn·nāh ū·ḇə·ṯit·têḵ ’eṯ·nān lō nit·tan- wə·’eṯ·nan lāḵ wat·tə·hî lə·he·p̄eḵ
verses.literal: So your prostitution is the opposite of that of other women No one solicited your favors and you paid a fee instead of receiving one so you are the very opposite

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן זוֹנָ֔ה שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên zō·w·nāh šim·‘î də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore O prostitute hear the word of the LORD

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אָמַ֞ר יַ֣עַן הִשָּׁפֵ֤ךְ נְחֻשְׁתֵּךְ֙ וַתִּגָּלֶ֣ה עֶרְוָתֵ֔ךְ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ עַל־ מְאַהֲבָ֑יִךְ וְעַל֙ כָּל־ תוֹעֲבוֹתַ֔יִךְ גִּלּוּלֵ֣י וְכִדְמֵ֣י בָנַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תְּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an hiš·šā·p̄êḵ nə·ḥuš·têḵ wat·tig·gā·leh ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ bə·ṯaz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al- mə·’a·hă·ḇā·yiḵ wə·‘al kāl- ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ gil·lū·lê wə·ḵiḏ·mê ḇā·na·yiḵ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat lā·hem
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers and with all your detestable idols and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן הִנְנִ֨י מְקַבֵּ֤ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ מְאַהֲבַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָרַ֣בְתְּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהַ֔בְתְּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את וְקִבַּצְתִּי֩ אֹתָ֨ם עָלַ֜יִךְ מִסָּבִ֗יב וְגִלֵּיתִ֤י עֶרְוָתֵךְ֙ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְרָא֖וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֶרְוָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî mə·qab·bêṣ ’eṯ- kāl- mə·’a·hă·ḇa·yiḵ ’ă·šer ‘ā·raḇt ‘ă·lê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ā·haḇt ‘al kāl- ’ă·šer śā·nêṯ wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’ō·ṯām ‘ā·la·yiḵ mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḡil·lê·ṯî ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ ’ă·lê·hem wə·rā·’ū ’eṯ- kāl- ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: therefore I will surely gather - all the lovers with whom you found pleasure all those you loved - and all those you hated I will gather them against you from all around and expose [you] before them and they will see you - completely naked

verses.original: וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵ֣י נֹאֲפ֔וֹת וְשֹׁפְכֹ֖ת דָּ֑ם וּנְתַתִּ֕יךְ חֵמָ֖ה דַּ֥ם וְקִנְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·p̄aṭ·tîḵ miš·pə·ṭê nō·’ă·p̄ō·wṯ wə·šō·p̄ə·ḵōṯ dām ū·nə·ṯat·tîḵ ḥê·māh dam wə·qin·’āh
verses.literal: And I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood so I will bring upon you the wrath of your bloodshed and jealousy

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אוֹתָ֜ךְ בְּיָדָ֗ם וְהָרְס֤וּ גַבֵּךְ֙ וְנִתְּצ֣וּ רָמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְהִפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּגָדַ֔יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ תִפְאַרְתֵּ֑ךְ כְּלֵ֣י וְהִנִּיח֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·yā·ḏām wə·hā·rə·sū ḡab·bêḵ wə·nit·tə·ṣū rā·mō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·hip̄·šî·ṭū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·ḡā·ḏa·yiḵ wə·lā·qə·ḥū ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ kə·lê wə·hin·nî·ḥūḵ ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh
verses.literal: Then I will deliver you into the hands [of your lovers] and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines They will strip off - your clothes take your fine jewelry and leave you naked and bare

verses.original: וְהֶעֱל֤וּ קָהָ֔ל עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ וְרָגְמ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖ךְ בָּאָ֑בֶן וּבִתְּק֖וּךְ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·lū qā·hāl ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·rā·ḡə·mū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bā·’ā·ḇen ū·ḇit·tə·qūḵ bə·ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They will bring a mob against you who will stone you . . . and cut you to pieces with their swords

verses.original: וְשָׂרְפ֤וּ בָּאֵ֔שׁ בָתַּ֙יִךְ֙ וְעָשׂוּ־ שְׁפָטִ֔ים בָ֣ךְ לְעֵינֵ֖י רַבּ֑וֹת נָשִׁ֣ים וְהִשְׁבַּתִּיךְ֙ מִזּוֹנָ֔ה לֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃ וְגַם־ תִתְּנִי־ אֶתְנַ֖ן
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·rə·p̄ū bā·’êš ḇāt·ta·yiḵ wə·‘ā·śū- šə·p̄ā·ṭîm ḇāḵ lə·‘ê·nê rab·bō·wṯ nā·šîm wə·hiš·bat·tîḵ miz·zō·w·nāh lō ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḡam- ṯit·tə·nî- ’eṯ·nan
verses.literal: Then they will burn down . . . your houses and execute judgment against you in the sight of many women I will put an end to your prostitution and you will never . . . again pay your lovers

verses.original: וַהֲנִחֹתִ֤י חֲמָתִי֙ בָּ֔ךְ קִנְאָתִ֖י וְסָ֥רָה מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֣קַטְתִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃ אֶכְעַ֖ס
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ni·ḥō·ṯî ḥă·mā·ṯî bāḵ qin·’ā·ṯî wə·sā·rāh mim·mêḵ wə·šā·qaṭ·tî wə·lō ‘ō·wḏ ’eḵ·‘as
verses.literal: So I will lay to rest My wrath against you and My jealousy will turn away from you Then I will be calm and no longer angry

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ זָכַרְתִּי אֶת־ יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ וַתִּרְגְּזִי־ לִ֖י בְּכָל־ אֵ֑לֶּה אֲנִ֨י הֵ֜א וְגַם־ דַּרְכֵּ֣ךְ׀ נָתַ֗תִּי בְּרֹ֣אשׁ נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְלֹ֤א עָשִׂיתִי אֶת־ הַזִּמָּ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer lō- zå̄·ḵar·tī ’eṯ- yə·mê nə·‘ū·ra·yiḵ wat·tir·gə·zî- lî bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh ’ă·nî hê wə·ḡam- dar·kêḵ nā·ṯat·tî bə·rōš nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·lō ʿå̄·śī·ṯī ’eṯ- haz·zim·māh ‘al kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Because - you did not remember - the days of your youth but enraged Me with all these things . . . I will surely bring your deeds down upon your own head declares the Lord GOD Have you not committed - this lewdness on top of all your [other] abominations

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ כָּל־ הַמֹּשֵׁ֔ל יִמְשֹׁ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר עָלַ֥יִךְ כְּאִמָּ֖ה בִּתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh kāl- ham·mō·šêl yim·šōl lê·mōr ‘ā·la·yiḵ kə·’im·māh bit·tāh
verses.literal: Behold all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb . . . about you Like mother like daughter

verses.original: אַ֔תְּ בַּת־ אִמֵּ֣ךְ גֹּעֶ֥לֶת אִישָׁ֖הּ וּבָנֶ֑יהָ אַ֗תְּ וַאֲח֨וֹת אֲחוֹתֵ֜ךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר גָּֽעֲ֙לוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ן וּבְנֵיהֶ֔ן אִמְּכֶ֣ן חִתִּ֔ית וַאֲבִיכֶ֖ן אֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’at baṯ- ’im·mêḵ gō·‘e·leṯ ’î·šāh ū·ḇā·ne·hā ’at wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ ’ă·šer gā·‘ă·lū ’an·šê·hen ū·ḇə·nê·hen ’im·mə·ḵen ḥit·tîṯ wa·’ă·ḇî·ḵen ’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: You are the daughter of your mother who despised her husband and children You are the sister of your sisters who despised their husbands and children Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite

verses.original: הַגְּדוֹלָ֤ה וַאֲחוֹתֵ֨ךְ שֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ הִ֣יא הַיּוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ עַל־ שְׂמֹאולֵ֑ךְ הַקְּטַנָּ֣ה וַאֲחוֹתֵ֞ךְ סְדֹ֖ם הַיּוֹשֶׁ֙בֶת֙ וּבְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ מִמֵּ֗ךְ מִֽימִינֵ֔ךְ
verses.transliteration: hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh wa·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ šō·mə·rō·wn hî hay·yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ‘al- śə·mō·w·lêḵ haq·qə·ṭan·nāh wa·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ sə·ḏōm hay·yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā mim·mêḵ mî·mî·nêḵ
verses.literal: Your older sister was Samaria who lived with her daughters to your north and your younger sister was Sodom who lived with her daughters to your south

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א הָלַ֔כְתְּ מֵהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃ בְדַרְכֵיהֶן֙ עָשִׂיתִי וּבְתוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֖ן כִּמְעַ֣ט קָ֔ט וַתַּשְׁחִ֥תִי
verses.transliteration: wə·lō hā·laḵt mê·hên bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵā·yiḵ ḇə·ḏar·ḵê·hen ʿå̄·śī·ṯī ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hen kim·‘aṭ qāṭ wat·taš·ḥi·ṯî
verses.literal: And you not only walked in their - - ways and practiced their abominations but soon you were . . . more depraved than they were

verses.original: אָ֗נִי חַי־ נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ הִ֖יא סְדֹ֣ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ אִם־ עָֽשְׂתָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֖תְּ וּבְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃ עָשִׂ֔ית
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nî ḥay- nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ hî sə·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ’im- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh ka·’ă·šer ’at ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯā·yiḵ ‘ā·śîṯ
verses.literal: As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD your sister . . . Sodom and her daughters never did as you and your daughters have done

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ זֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה עֲוֺ֖ן אֲחוֹתֵ֑ךְ סְדֹ֣ם לָהּ֙ וְלִבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיַד־ הָ֤יָה גָּא֨וֹן שִׂבְעַת־ לֶ֜חֶם הַשְׁקֵ֗ט וְשַׁלְוַ֣ת לֹ֥א הֶחֱזִֽיקָה׃ עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֖וֹן
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- zeh hā·yāh ‘ă·wōn ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ sə·ḏōm lāh wə·liḇ·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·yaḏ- hā·yāh gā·’ō·wn śiḇ·‘aṯ- le·ḥem haš·qêṭ wə·šal·waṯ lō he·ḥĕ·zî·qāh ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: Now this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom She and her daughters . . . were arrogant overfed . . . and complacent . . . they did not help the poor and needy

verses.original: וַֽתִּגְבְּהֶ֔ינָה וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה תוֹעֵבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י וָאָסִ֥יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·bə·he·nāh wat·ta·‘ă·śe·nāh ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh lə·p̄ā·nāy wā·’ā·sîr ’eṯ·hen ka·’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî
verses.literal: Thus they were haughty and committed abominations before Me Therefore I removed them as you have seen

verses.original: וְשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן לֹ֣א חָטָ֑אָה כַּחֲצִ֥י חַטֹּאתַ֖יִךְ וַתַּרְבִּ֤י אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ מֵהֵ֔נָּה בְּכָל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂיתי׃ אֲחוֹתֵךְ וַתְּצַדְּקִי֙ אֶת־
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·mə·rō·wn lō ḥā·ṭā·’āh ka·ḥă·ṣî ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯa·yiḵ wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ mê·hên·nāh bə·ḵāl tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer ʿå̄·śī·ṯ ʾă·ḥō·ṯēḵ wat·tə·ṣad·də·qî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Furthermore, Samaria did not commit half the sins you did You have multiplied - your abominations beyond theirs and all the abominations - you have committed have made your sisters appear righteous -

verses.original: גַּם־ אַ֣תְּ׀ שְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֗ךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּלַּלְתְּ֙ לַֽאֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ תִּצְדַּ֣קְנָה מִמֵּ֑ךְ בְּחַטֹּאתַ֛יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־ הִתְעַ֥בְתְּ מֵהֵ֖ן אַ֥תְּ וְגַם־ וּשְׂאִ֣י בּ֙וֹשִׁי֙ כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ אַחְיוֹתֵֽךְ׃ בְּצַדֶּקְתֵּ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: gam- ’at śə·’î ḵə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ ’ă·šer pil·lalt la·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ tiṣ·daq·nāh mim·mêḵ bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer- hiṯ·‘aḇt mê·hên ’at wə·ḡam- ū·śə·’î bō·wō·šî ḵə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ ’aḥ·yō·w·ṯêḵ bə·ṣad·deq·têḵ
verses.literal: So now you must bear your disgrace since you have brought justification for your sisters For they appear more righteous than you because your sins - were more vile than theirs So you too must bear your shame and disgrace since you have made your sisters appear righteous

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֶת־ שְׁבִית סְדֹם֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שְׁבִ֣יתְהֶ֔ן וְאֶת־ שְׁבִית שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ וּשְׁבִית שְׁבִיתַ֖יִךְ בְּתוֹכָֽהְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- ’eṯ- šə·ḇīṯ sə·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā šə·ḇî·ṯə·hen wə·’eṯ- šə·ḇīṯ šō·mə·rō·wn ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ū·šə·ḇīṯ šə·ḇî·ṯa·yiḵ bə·ṯō·w·ḵā·hə·nāh
verses.literal: But I will restore - - - Sodom and her daughters from captivity - as well as Samaria and her daughters And I will restore you . . . along with them

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ וְנִכְלַ֕מְתְּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית בְּנַחֲמֵ֖ךְ אֹתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tiś·’î ḵə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·niḵ·lamt mik·kōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ bə·na·ḥă·mêḵ ’ō·ṯān
verses.literal: So you will bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all - you did to comfort them -

verses.original: וַאֲחוֹתַ֗יִךְ סְדֹ֤ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וְשֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ תָּשֹׁ֣בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֔ן וְאַתְּ֙ וּבְנוֹתַ֔יִךְ תְּשֻׁבֶ֖ינָה לְקַדְמַתְכֶֽן׃ תָּשֹׁ֖בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֑ן
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯa·yiḵ sə·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·šō·mə·rō·wn ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā tā·šō·ḇə·nā lə·qaḏ·mā·ṯān wə·’at ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ tə·šu·ḇe·nāh lə·qaḏ·maṯ·ḵen tā·šō·ḇə·nā lə·qaḏ·mā·ṯān
verses.literal: And your sisters Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters will return to their former state You and your daughters . . . . . . will also return to your former state

verses.original: וְל֤וֹא הָֽיְתָה֙ בְּפִ֑יךְ אֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ סְדֹ֣ם לִשְׁמוּעָ֖ה בְּי֖וֹם גְּאוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō·w hā·yə·ṯāh bə·p̄îḵ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ sə·ḏōm liš·mū·‘āh bə·yō·wm gə·’ō·w·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Did you not treat . . . your sister Sodom as an object of scorn in the day of your pride

verses.original: בְּטֶרֶם֮ רָעָתֵךְ֒ תִּגָּלֶ֣ה כְּמ֗וֹ עֵ֚ת חֶרְפַּ֣ת בְּנוֹת־ אֲרָ֔ם וְכָל־ סְבִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים מִסָּבִֽיב׃ הַשָּׁאט֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ tig·gā·leh kə·mōw ‘êṯ ḥer·paṯ bə·nō·wṯ- ’ă·rām wə·ḵāl sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā bə·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm mis·sā·ḇîḇ haš·šā·ṭō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: before your wickedness was uncovered Even so you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all those around her and by the daughters of the Philistines all those around you who despise you

verses.original: אֶת־ אַ֣תְּ נְשָׂאתִ֑ים זִמָּתֵ֥ךְ וְאֶת־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִךְ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’at nə·śā·ṯîm zim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: - You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your abominations declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ וְעָשִׂית אוֹתָ֖ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית אֲשֶׁר־ בָּזִ֥ית אָלָ֖ה לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar wə·ʿå̄·śīṯ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ ’ă·šer- bā·zîṯ ’ā·lāh lə·hā·p̄êr bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says I will deal with you according to your deeds since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י אֶת־ וְזָכַרְתִּ֨י בְּרִיתִ֛י בְּרִ֥ית אוֹתָ֖ךְ בִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ וַהֲקִמוֹתִ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃ לָ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’eṯ- wə·zā·ḵar·tî bə·rî·ṯî bə·rîṯ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bî·mê nə·‘ū·rā·yiḵ wa·hă·qi·mō·w·ṯî ‘ō·w·lām lāḵ
verses.literal: But I - will remember the covenant . . . I made with you in the days of your youth and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you

verses.original: וְזָכַ֣רְתְּ אֶת־ דְּרָכַיִךְ֮ וְנִכְלַמְתְּ֒ בְּקַחְתֵּ֗ךְ אֶת־ הַגְּדֹל֣וֹת אֶל־ מִמֵּ֔ךְ הַקְּטַנּ֖וֹת מִמֵּ֑ךְ אֲחוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶתְהֶ֥ן לָ֛ךְ לְבָנ֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א מִבְּרִיתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵart ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵa·yiḵ wə·niḵ·lamt bə·qaḥ·têḵ ’eṯ- hag·gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’el- mim·mêḵ haq·qə·ṭan·nō·wṯ mim·mêḵ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯa·yiḵ wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ·hen lāḵ lə·ḇā·nō·wṯ wə·lō mib·bə·rî·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Then you will remember - your ways and be ashamed when you receive - your older and younger . . . sisters I will give them to you as daughters but not because of My covenant with you

verses.original: אֲנִ֛י אֶת־ וַהֲקִימוֹתִ֥י בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’eṯ- wa·hă·qî·mō·w·ṯî bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tāḵ wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: So I - will establish My covenant with you and you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן בְּכַפְּרִי־ לָךְ֙ לְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית תִּזְכְּרִי֙ וָבֹ֔שְׁתְּ וְלֹ֨א יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֥ךְ עוֹד֙ פִּתְח֣וֹן פֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י כְּלִמָּתֵ֑ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an bə·ḵap·pə·rî- lāḵ lə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ tiz·kə·rî wā·ḇō·šət wə·lō yih·yeh- lāḵ ‘ō·wḏ piṯ·ḥō·wn peh mip·pə·nê kə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: so that when I make atonement for all you have done you will remember and be ashamed and never . . . again open your mouth because of your disgrace declares the Lord GOD
